Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hmm...
...？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, is something wrong？
Huh？ Hmm, what should I do... Should I just tell you？ ...Wanna hear it？
Now that you say that, I'm really curious.
So, you know Enoshima over in Shonan, right？ Don't you want to go？
Enoshima？
Yeah. We could do a day trip, and there's lots of good food to try! Plus, don't you think a date in Shonan sounds romantic？
Yeah, sounds great!
Wait, why？！ Enoshima has Benten-sama, you know？
？？？ Umm... what do you mean？
Geez! Couples aren't supposed to visit Benten-sama! She gets jealous and makes them break up!
Wait, what！？ Really？
That's the whole problem!
When I talked to my mom about it, she said: 'Oh, believing a superstition like that just means you lack confidence.' What do you think？
Confidence, as in... ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, well...
Yeah. Like, whether we really love each other, or...
Isn't it frustrating, hearing her say that？ We've got confidence, right？
Of course！
All right... Let's go after all. To Enoshima. Let's go and prove it!
Now then, where is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... You're looking a little... extra special today.
Yup. I really went all out! After all, I'm meeting Benten-sama.
I see. ...Wait. Won't being cuter just make her even more jealous...？
Maybe, but I want to look my best, you know？ It's a showdown! Ah... Don't tell me you're not confident？
No way!
Very good.
Hey, hey... Did you just say I was cuter than usual？
Yeah.
Hehe, very good. Let's go!
(...A girl's heart is a complicated thing？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! Are you here already？
Just a bit, yeah. I got here early.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Today you're looking a little extra...
...Hmm？
Cute.
Very good. I'm meeting Benten-sama, after all. How should I put it... I can't slack off. Especially woman to woman.
(...A girl's heart is a complicated thing？)
Anegasaki
Enoshima, huh... Hehe!
You seem excited, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Well, yeah! It's my first time going to Enoshima, after all. Besides, you know...
I've always wanted to ride the Enoden. Doesn't it feel way more like an actual date than a regular train？
Yeah, maybe it does.
Right？ We came all this way, so we've got to enjoy every minute of it. Hehe♪
Anegasaki
Ah... Hey, did you see that？ The train that was just stopped there!
...Hmm？
It looked vintage, it was so cute... The Enoden has so many different trains, huh？
Yeah, looks like it.
Right, right... Then if we come to Enoshima a whole bunch, maybe we can ride every one eventually.
Every one, huh...？ Wonder how many trips that would take.
We'll just come as many times as it takes, right？ Hehe!
Phew, we're here~ So this is Enoshima...
Anegasaki
Mmm! It feels just like a resort, I'm so excited!
Wait, huh？ Hey, where's Enoshima？
To the south, right？
Which way is south？
I saw the ocean from the window on that side of the train, so over that way.
Right, the Pacific Ocean! Right, right...
Spoken like a true guy. You're so reliable at times like this! Come on, let's hurry!
(Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s really having a good time.)
Phew, we're here!
Anegasaki
Here we are: Enoshima!
The sea is south, so Enoshima is that way! Right？
You're in high spirits, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Well of course! It's Enoshima, after all! Come on, let's hurry!
Anegasaki
Ah, is that...？ That's it, right？
Whoa, Enoshima!
It looks so close from here...
Yeah. We can see it so clearly...
Incredible... I really feel like we might run into Benten-sama at this rate...
Maybe so. I'm getting kind of excited!
Hmph... Are you sure you should be in tourist mode？ Sure, it's a date, but it's a showdown too, you know？
...Yes.
Another clear day today... We can see the island really well.
Anegasaki
It looks so close, like my voice could reach! Heeey, Enoshimaaa!
Whoa, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, don't get too carried away!
I don't care! Come on, you get hyped up too, let loose!
H-Heeey!
Heeey! Hehe!
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, aren't you getting hungry by now？
To be honest, I've been starving for a while...
I brought a boxed lunch, you know？
Awesome!
I thought local Enoshima specialties might be nice, but as your girlfriend, I just couldn't compromise. Wanna eat？
Don't mind if I do!
Good answer. Hehe! Now, why don't you find us a spot to eat lunch？
Alright. Where should we go first...？
How about ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Anegasaki
I see. Yeah, that sounds good.
Thanks for the food!
Anegasaki
Hehe, you're welcome. After all, you'd rate it higher if you ate mine before the Enoshima snacks, right？
So that was your plan... Well, now that we've eaten, where to next...？
Since we're already here, wanna head over to the Samuel Cocking Garden？
Sounds good, let's go!
Alright... Guess it's about time for that place...
We're going to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲, right？
Anegasaki
Yeah, definitely don't want to miss that one, right？
Next up has gotta be that place, huh...
Wanna go to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Anegasaki
Oh, good idea! Shall we？
Anegasaki
Hm？ ...Wait, huh？
What's wrong？
Hey, people actually live on Enoshima, right？
Yeah, there are quite a few regular houses here.
If Benten-sama really broke couples up, though... what would the lovers and married couples here do？
Oh, right... Then I guess it really is just a superstition.
Right？ Thought so. I see, I see... Ah.
Wait, could it be that everyone here is single or doesn't have a partner？
(Pretty sure that's not it...)
Anegasaki
Hmm...
Still worrying about that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah. The mystery just deepens. Benten-sama and matchmaking...
Isn't that whole 'Benten-sama getting jealous' thing just a superstition, after all？
I was starting to think so. But... Hey, did you notice？
Apparently, that shrine has a legend about a celestial maiden and a dragon.
A maiden and a dragon... What about them？
Yeah. Are the celestial maiden and Benten-sama the same？
I don't think so...
Then what about the three goddesses of Enoshima Shrine？
Those are... probably different too？
Either way, there are a lot of goddesses on Enoshima. Yep, we can't let our guard down just yet.
(This is getting pretty out of hand...)
Anegasaki
*Phew*... There sure are a lot of stairs...
Yeah, it's quite a ways from the bottom to the top.
There was that 'Escar,' right？ I wonder if taking that would get us up in no time？
It's an escalator, right？ Want to ride it？
Yeah... Actually, no, never mind.
Why？
I mean, wouldn't it feel like we lost somehow？ To the goddesses, I mean.
Is that how it works？
That's just how it is. Come on, hang in there!
(Pretty sure Benten-sama has nothing to do with this now...)
Wait... That must be it...
Scared of what？
Could Benzaiten and the heavenly maiden from the legend... be the same person？
Why？
Listen. In the legend, the dragon falls for the maiden and they get married, right？ If Benzaiten interfered, they would've broken up way before that, right？
Ah, good point...
See？ Which means Benzaiten and the maiden are the exact same person! She looked so gentle, too, so I'm sure of it.
So then, Benzaiten's jealousy is...
Yep! She was falsely accused! Way to go, Nene-chan! Enoshima legend solved!
Still, it was bad of us to doubt her, huh？ Let's apologize to her on the way back, okay？ Hehe!
Anegasaki
Mmm... The ocean is so pretty today. The sea breeze feels great!
Yeah, it feels so nice...
Along this path, you can catch glimpses of the ocean, right？ Doesn't it really feel like being on an island？
Yeah. You can see really far out.
And the weather's nice, too？ It feels like a Shonan date... Oh, right! Hey, hey.
Say something like a cool Shonan guy again？
Huh!? Uhh, well...
Whoa... It's really bustling.
Anegasaki
Yeah. It feels so lively! Lots of souvenir shops. And it smells delicious, too.
They sell all kinds of stuff.
Grilled turban shell, clams... Shirasu is famous here, too. Oh, whole-grilled octopus rice crackers!
Wanna grab a bite of something？
Huh？ Umm... no, we can't.
Why？
Well, you know...
Right! If we eat snacks out here, Benzaiten past the torii gate might see us, you know？
No way!
Letting your guard down is dangerous! So just looking until lunch. Got it？
(Until lunch？)
So this is Hetsumiya...
Anegasaki
Yeah, Benzaiten's shrine. We're finally here...
We've got confidence, right？ You and me...
Yeah... let's go.
*sigh*... That was kind of an anticlimax... Benzaiten looked way gentler than I expected, don't you think？
Did you expect her to be scarier？
Well... And besides, they say this shrine actually blesses couples with good matchmaking.
Yeah. Tons of pink ema plaques. They're from couples, right？
Geez, which is it, then？
Hey, don't ask ●...
Hmm...
Chigogafuchi, huh... What an incredible view...
Anegasaki
It really is... It looks like somewhere a dragon would rampage in a movie.
Whoa, it's chilly inside...
Yes...
It feels so mystical. A dragon god lives here, after all... Wait, huh？
Are the Dragon God and that five-headed dragon from the legend the same？
I wonder... Though it looked like the Dragon God only had one head.
If they're the same, do you think the maiden lived here with him too？
I guess so.
I see... Then this place might have been their love nest.
Let's go with that, okay？ I mean, doesn't thinking of it like that make it a romantic spot？ Right？
Yeah, let's go with that.
Anegasaki
Mmm, smells so good! Hey, what should we eat？
Is it okay today？ Won't Benten-sama be watching...？
It's fine. We're friends now, after all. Hehe！
I see. Well then, ●...
Hey, can you eat the bitter part of a turban shell？
The bitter part？
See, I love the white part, but... Will you eat the bitter part for me？
Sure. Then, ●...
Look, look! Whitebait ice cream! Talk about adventurous... What should we do？
Whitebait ice cream, huh. Then—
Oh, we also have to try the whole-grilled octopus cracker from Asahi Honten! Come on, let's go！
(I just hope ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't upset her stomach...)
Anegasaki
Hey, we're going to pay our respects to Benten-sama, right？
Yeah.
We doubted her so much before, that was awful of us. She's forgiven us by now, right？
It'll be fine. She's a kind goddess, after all.
Kind, and beautiful too, right？
Yeah.
I'll go by myself. You stay right there.
(Turns out ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is the jealous one...)
Chigogafuchi, huh... No matter when you come, it's an incredible view...
Anegasaki
Let's go greet the Dragon God.
Hey, hey... Whenever I come here, there's something that always bugs me...
There's an info sign about sea roaches, right？ Well, on it, it says "extremely bad-tasting"...
Okay...
Did someone actually eat one？ A sea roach...？
...Someone must have.
Uuuugh...
Anegasaki
So many families. The Samuel Cocking Garden really is a must-visit when you come to Enoshima.
It is the very top of Enoshima, after all.
Hey, we're going up the lighthouse, right？ Let's go！
Incredible... You can see so far！
Yeah. The weather's great, too.
It really is. The sea breeze is strong, too! But it's so much fun! Hehe！
Yeah, it's a nice breeze...
Ah! Hey, hey...
What？
You looked kinda cool just now, you know？ Like a real Shonan boy.
(This is embarrassing...)
Oh, it's Ryugu.
Anegasaki
Yeah. That mouth is huge...
Well, it is a dragon...
Right, it's a dragon... Wait, doesn't it only have one head？
Yeah... Looks that way.
The legendary dragon has five heads, after all. Maybe it's a different one...？
Maybe there's a sign somewhere that explains it？
Aw, where's the fun in that？ You've got no sense of romance.
I'm sorry...
Anegasaki
Phew... We made it!
Those stairs, though...
Yeah... The view is great, though.
Besides, it feels like you haven't really been to Enoshima unless you come all the way up here...
Yeah, I think I know what you mean...
Hehe, then it couldn't be helped, right？
Guess so？
Still, time for a break. *sigh*...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, wouldn't this be a great spot for a photo？
Yeah. Alright, shall we take one？
Alright, let's do it!
Anegasaki
Hey, wouldn't it be nice to take a photo here？
Yeah, good idea... Alright!
Let's get a photo for our Enoshima memories.
Anegasaki
Hey, could you take a photo？ I really want a shot of today's sunset.
Alright...
Huh？ What's this？
Anegasaki
What？
Whoa... What's going on here？
Not sure, but between the sun's angle and lens refraction, it's probably just a trick of the light...
A trick of the light, huh...
Hey, how about we look at it this way instead？
This is a celestial robe gifted by the maiden— Lady Benten herself— to make peace with us. Right？
Yes...
That'll be our very own Enoshima legend. Thank you, Lady Benten.
...Hmm？
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ Oh, could it be...？
Yeah.
Whoa... Amazing!! She gave us another gift! It's so pretty...
Yeah, you look just like a real heavenly maiden...
Wait, when I said pretty, I didn't mean— I was talking about the robe...
Still, that makes me happy... Thank you.
Well then... The sun's starting to go down soon.
Anegasaki
Yeah... *sigh* Just when we finally solved the mystery, too. What a shame.
Is there anywhere else we can swing by right now？
Hmm... Oh, look! How about over there？
The “Bell of Dragon Love”...？
Doesn't that sound romantic？ I bet it's connected to the maiden and the dragon.
Yeah, sounds like it.
It's decided! That'll be our last stop.
Anegasaki
Hey, ready to head over？
Hm？ Oh, right.
Yep, the “Bell of Dragon Love.” Let's end our day in Enoshima on a romantic note, okay？
Alright, let's go!
The sunset's incredible...
Anegasaki
It really is... so pretty. Hey, do you think that's the Bell of Dragon Love？
Yeah, let's.
I see... Oh look, so many padlocks. Couples must have left them here, right...？
Anegasaki
Doesn't this remind you？ You know, back in Atami...
Cape Aijo, right？
Yes...
Anegasaki
Which means... Enoshima really brings couples together, after all. I see...
To tell you the truth... when my mom said that, it really shook me.
By your mom？
You know... She said, “You're not confident, are you？” I knew she was just joking, I really did, but...
Getting worried over a silly superstition like that... Maybe it was proof that, deep down, I really wasn't confident in us...
So that's how you felt...
That's why, when you said you'd come along with me, it made me so happy.
“As long as I'm with him, we'll be fine no matter what.” It gave me the courage to see for myself.
I see...
Spending today together... we proved it, didn't we？ That as long as we're together, we'll be just fine.
Yeah.
Yeah... Hehe. Hey, that bell...
Do you think that, just like the maiden and the dragon, ringing it together means we'll be together forever...？
Alright, let's give it a ring.
What a mysterious sound... Does this mean we'll be together forever now？
There's a sign here. Want to read it？
...No. Today, it's just a bell with a mysterious sound. No more legends. Instead... do something I can believe in even more？
As long as we're together, we'll always be okay...
Yes...
The sunset's incredible...
Anegasaki
Yeah, it's so pretty...
Hey, is that the Bell of Dragon Love？ There are so many padlocks hanging on it...
You're right.
Anegasaki
Hey, doesn't this remind you of something？ You know...
Oh, right... back in Atami...
Very good. Hehe, yep, Cape Aijo.
Anegasaki
Which means... this place really does bring lovers together, too.
Is it still bothering you？
I'm fine now. Because you...
When my mom told me, “You must not be confident,” truth is... it made me a little anxious.
I mean, if I really trusted how we felt, something like that shouldn't have bothered me at all, right？
Of course, I'm okay now. But what if...？
What if you heard about Benten and didn't want to come here with me...？ So... I tested you. ...I'm sorry, okay？
So that's what that was...
But you came anyway. Because you're confident in how we feel. Aren't you？
Yeah.
Very good. You pass! Hehe.
Oh, hey... Wanna go ring that bell？
That bell... isn't that for tying the knot—
Maybe so. But today it's a passing bell. Proof that you really believed in me.
All right, let's ring it.
Hm？ Maybe that didn't sound much like passing？
Just a little, yeah...
Hehe, but still, you get a perfect score. Hey... what do you want for your reward？
That's...
Mmh. That gets a hundred, too. ...I love you.
Me, too...
The sunset's incredible...
Anegasaki
Hehe, it's just as romantic as I thought it'd be, huh？
Hey, is that the Bell of Ryuren？ Look, there are so many padlocks couples left behind.
Anegasaki
Hey, seeing those... doesn't it take you back？ To Cape Aijo.
It sure does.
Anegasaki
Enoshima really is for lovers, after all. All that worry for nothing, hehe...
To be honest, when Mom asked if I was feeling insecure, it really stung.
Oh, was it？
Of course, she was only joking. I know that, but still...
What if legends like that actually have some truth？ So I got a little defensive... I was acting weird today, wasn't I？
A little, yeah.
Thought so. *sigh*... I feel so silly.
Not at all.
Thanks. But I'm okay now. Spending today with you was so much fun...
It showed me for sure that we really do believe in each other.
Yeah, it was.
Plus, we even solved the legend's mystery, right？ Hehe! Oh, speaking of which, that bell...
I wonder if ringing it together grants you eternity, just like the maiden and the dragon？
There's an explanation here, wanna read it？
Mmm... nah. I'll pass.
Are you sure—
We make our own legend. So today, that bell is...
I know! It's our promise to Benten-sama that we'll be together forever.
All right, let's ring it.
Think she heard us...？
I'm sure she did...
Hey... wanna seal that promise？
I love you.
Me, too...
The sunset's incredible today, too...
Anegasaki
Yeah. There's no better way to end a day in Enoshima than this... Romantic, right？
Yeah.
Hehe! *sigh*... Today was so much fun! Benten-sama was in a great mood, too.
Was she？
I mean, look... Aren't we getting along so well again today？
I see.
See？ Hehe! Well then, shall we ring the bell soon？
What's today's bell for？
Today's bell？ Hmm, let's see...
A bell to report to Benten-sama, 'We were so lovey-dovey today, ▼!'
It's a little embarrassing, but... All right, let's ring it!
Hehe! Does that sound like a lovey-dovey ring？
Not quite what you pictured？
It's fine like this. Here's proof of our love. ...See？
Did she get how in love we are, I wonder？
Yes...
Anegasaki
That was so fun... Hey, aren't you glad we took the plunge and came？
Yeah, it was.
I can hardly believe how worried I was on the way here.
I wasn't sure how it'd turn out at first, though.
Totally. But I'm so glad. We even solved the mystery of the legend, right？ Hehe... Oh.
Hold on a second...
Thanks for waiting. Look at this strap!
Isn't this what Benten-sama was holding？
Yep, a biwa! Cute, right~？ Not giving it to you, though! Hehe!
Look, the train's here. Shall we go？
All right~
(Looks like this became a great memory for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Anegasaki
Mmm... We sure had a lot of fun today, didn't we？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you always get so excited whenever we come to Enoshima, don't you？
I guess？ Though it's always a little sad when it's time to go...
Look, the train's here. Shall we go？
Yeah.
We'll come visit again, Benten-sama...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s totally become a fan of Benten-sama...)
